query: کالای DRI امروز از انبار مواد اولیه مصرفی تولید، به کدوم انبار انتقال داده شده؟
sql:
SELECT TOP (1) Store_2.Title
FROM Voucher
JOIN Store ON Inv_Voucher.Store_id = Store.Id
JOIN Store AS Store_2 ON Inv_Voucher.COUNTER_PART_STORE_ID = Store_2.id
JOIN Inv_Voucher_Item ON Inv_Voucher.id = Inv_Voucher_Item.INVENTORY_VOUCHER_ID
JOIN Voucher_Specification ON Voucher_Specification.Id = Inv_Voucher.Voucher_Specification_id
WHERE Inv_Voucher.DATE = CAST(getdate() AS DATE)
	AND store.title LIKE ‘%مواد اولیه مصرفی تولید%’
	AND Inv_Voucher.COUNTER_PART_STORE_ID IS NOT NULL
	AND Inv_Voucher.STATE IN (
		‘تایید شده’
		,’ثبت شده’)
	AND VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION.Voucher_Type = ‘انتقال بین انبار’
model_response:
```
SELECT ivi.PART_REF, p.TITLE, iv.NUMBER, iv.DATE, s.CODE, s.TITLE 
FROM INV_VOCHER iv 
JOIN INV_VOCHER_ITEM ivi ON iv.ID = ivi.VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION_REF 
JOIN STORE s ON iv.STORE_REF2 = s.ID 
JOIN PART p ON ivi.PART_REF = p.ID 
WHERE p.TITLE = 'DRI' AND iv.DATE = (SELECT MAX(DATE) FROM INV_VOCHER WHERE DATE <= CURRENT_DATE) AND iv.VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION_REF IN (
  SELECT vs.ID 
  FROM VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION vs 
  WHERE vs.VOUCHER_TYPE = 'انتقال بین انبار' AND vs.DIRECTION = 'خروجی'
);
```

query: لیست تمام کالاهایی که امروز به انبار "دارایی های ثابت" انتقال داده شده اند رو میخوام
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT Part.Title
FROM Inv_Voucher_Item
JOIN Inv_Voucher ON Inv_Voucher_Item.Inventory_Voucher_id = Inv_Voucher.Id
JOIN part ON Inv_Voucher_Item.Part_id = Part.Id
JOIN Store ON Store.Id = Inv_Voucher.COUNTER_PART_STORE_ID
JOIN VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION ON Inv_Voucher.VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION_ID = VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION.Id
WHERE Inv_Voucher.DATE = CAST(getdate() AS DATE)
	AND Inv_Voucher.COUNTER_PART_STORE_ID IS NOT NULL
	AND VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION.Voucher_Type = ‘انتقال بین انبار’
	AND Inv_Voucher.STATE IN (
		‘تایید شده’
		,’ثبت شده’)
model_response:
```
SELECT p.TITLE, ivi.QUANTITY, u.TITLE AS UNIT_TITLE
FROM INV_VOUCHER iv
JOIN INV_VOUCHER_ITEM ivi ON iv.ID = ivi.VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION_REF
JOIN PART p ON ivi.PART_REF = p.ID
JOIN UNIT u ON ivi.UNIT_REF = u.ID
WHERE iv.STATE = 'ثبت شده' AND iv.DATE = CURRENT_DATE AND iv.STORE_REF2 IN (
  SELECT s.ID
  FROM STORE s
  WHERE s.TITLE = 'دارایی های ثابت'
)
AND iv.VOUCHER_SPECIFICATION_REF IN (
```
